notes: Third dispatch, from commit 3f7e2f1. The second build (9fe732b) loaded the MIGraphX provider, but Frigate's detector process aborted on a protobuf descriptor collision: MIGraphX's TensorFlow parser and OpenCV's dnn module both link nixpkgs' shared libprotobuf and both register tensor_shape.proto, so any process that has imported cv2 dies when the provider loads. 3f7e2f1 builds MIGraphX against a static protobuf (private descriptor pool, gfx1100 and gfx1103 device code) and rebuilds onnxruntime against it. The dry run lists 18 derivations: protobuf, migraphx, onnxruntime, the Python wheel, tf2onnx, keras, faster-whisper, sherpa-onnx, frigate and the system glue. Expect two to three hours. Before activation, run the detector-shaped smoke test as the frigate user from /: import cv2 and frigate.detectors, then open a MIGraphX session on yolov8s.onnx; it must report MIGraphXExecutionProvider first and infer in under 10 ms. Then make test-ser8.
